entries.what: Drop the soap and the ghost starts hunting. Every time. It has happened more than once on stream.
A childhood favorite, revisited years later for an honest review. The verdict: it is not good anymore.
Hit something mid-drive and took the roof clean off. The RV is a convertible now.
A glitch that handed out endless invisible matches, plus some arms bending in ways arms should not.
Last words before getting taken out by a ghost: a shout-out to Taco Bell.
Question of the Day: quick would-you-rather questions for chat, like dream house or dream car.
